human_review_plan.verification: Open MCP docs and verify server is maintained by Airtable
human_review_plan.match: MCP server should be in airtable.com domain or verified GitHub repo

human_review_plan.verification: Check Shopify API docs for preference statement
human_review_plan.match: Docs should state GraphQL is preferred

human_review_plan.match: Repo should be under github.com organization

human_review_plan.verification: Verify OAuth flow details and scope requirements
human_review_plan.match: OAuth endpoints should be documented with scopes
